construction: Fixed rank-767 T=I+(u-v)v^T on Cars blocks 9–11; u is the leading target output-task-vector direction, v minimizes normalized target input/output covariance orthogonal to u and ones. Fold LayerNorm affine parameters into input maps; apply T to their right and to branch outputs on the left. No response fit or strength/rank search.
limits: Standard linear algebra; no novelty or security claim. LayerNorm and nonlinear blocks do not generally commute with T. Low calibration energy and parameter rank loss do not guarantee utility, merging harm, or recovery cost.
calibration: Reuse 256 target training images from the audited block-recovery control; no labels for construction. Official test images were inspected in previous diagnostics. No test-based selection or independent confirmation claim.
controls: Original validated baseline; neutral affine-folding control T=I; identical public LayerNorm canonicalization and anchor-based completion on control and protected models. Attacks use released and public weights only, without calibration or teacher queries.
screen: 12 complete Cars evaluations plus two validated baseline rows. Freeze release before loading partners. If utility or the public recovery screen fails, close this candidate. Otherwise test original AGA, whole-block erasure, partner costs, and matched query recovery. Unrun attacks are not passed.
